title: WordPress 7.0 “Armstrong”
content:
WordPress 7.0 is here!

A major release enhancing your website with AI features and a refreshed admin experience.

  • Central AI Hub: Explore AI capabilities managed from a unified dashboard.
  • New Admin Theme: Experience a sleek design for an improved navigation experience.
  • Expanded Developer Toolbox: Gain more control with new blocks and design tools.
